QUOTE: A consumer who writes `ctx.reseed_counter` gets a compile error because the field is actually called `private_reseed_counter`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the macro renames the member (`private_##member`) so access by the original name fails at compile time. It also says the guard is compile-time only and that any translation unit can opt out, which matches the item. It never says the layout stays visible and sized, but the renaming mechanism is stated.
